subject.title: [Feature]: Session busy status reply + cancel option during long-running model responses

question: What busy-acknowledgement contract should OpenClaw expose for messages that arrive while the target session already has an active run?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but default-on behavior, config shape, reason vocabulary, and portable cancel/new-session actions affect channel UX and compatibility, so automation should not choose the policy alone.

options.title: Generic default with conservative actions
options.body: Add a shared default busy reply with non-destructive wait guidance, stable reason metadata, and typed optional stop/new actions only where the channel safely supports them.

options.title: Config-gated busy acknowledgements
options.body: Add disabled-by-default or per-channel busy-ack config first, accepting slower adoption to avoid changing existing channel noise and notification behavior.

options.title: Defer to durable status surface
options.body: Keep this issue blocked behind the broader persistent channel-turn status design, avoiding a smaller interim busy reply contract.

recommendation.title: Generic default with conservative actions
recommendation.body: Add a shared default busy reply with non-destructive wait guidance, stable reason metadata, and typed optional stop/new actions only where the channel safely supports them.

likelyOwner.reason: The active-run queue policy, queued-followup typing behavior, and prior canonical issue review all route through this owner signal.
